restrictions.scope_name: Panama Canal Neopanamax Locks (2016 Design Baseline)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Original baseline nominal design maximum LOA specification upon opening of expanded Neopanamax locks in June 2016 (historical baseline observation).
restrictions.source_publication_reference: ACP Notice to Shipping No. N-1-2016 ("Vessel Requirements"), Section 2, Table 1, Page 4
restrictions.conflict_details: Historical design baseline effective 2016-06-26; superseded for active commercial transit operations on 2021-06-01 by ACP Advisory A-19-2021 (370.33m LOA). Preserved as predecessor dated observation.

restrictions.source_publication_reference: ACP Advisory to Shipping No. A-19-2021 Section 1 & ACP Notice to Shipping No. N-1-2024 Section 2, Table 2, Page 5

restrictions.operating_conditions: Minimum required static Under-Keel Clearance for deep draft commercial vessels transiting Columbia River fresh water reaches.
Associated Branch Pilots (Bar Pilots) minimum 3 ft static UKC in Southwest Pass bar fairway.

restrictions.scope_name: Hooghly River Navigation Channel (Balari / Eastern Channel Bars)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Vessels with draft exceeding 6.5m must transit Hooghly River sandbars during daylight hours only due to shifting shoals and river current velocity.

Outer Harbour approaches directly from the Bay of Bengal into deepwater berths (VGCBL, OSTT, OB-1, OB-2) protected by detached breakwaters. VPA Navigational Guidelines Section 2 explicitly establishes that seaward approaches and Outer Harbour berths have zero overhead bridges, aerial cables, or vertical obstructions; air draft is unconstrained for all calling bulk and tanker vessels.
restrictions.source_publication_reference: VPA Port Information Guide 2024, Section 2.1 ("Outer Approaches, Fairway and Breakwater Basin") & Circular 2024/02

restrictions.scope_name: Paradip Port Entrance and Lagoon Basin
restrictions.operating_conditions: Paradip Port approach fairway, entrance channel between breakwaters, and central turning lagoon open directly to the Bay of Bengal. PPA Marine Department Guidelines Section 3 explicitly establishes that the fairway, entrance, and central basin have zero overhead bridges, aerial power transmission spans, or vertical obstructions; air draft is unconstrained for all calling vessels.
restrictions.source_publication_reference: PPA Information Handbook 2024, Section 3.2 ("Entrance Channel and Turning Basin Vertical Clearances") & Circular MD/SC/22/2023

restrictions.scope_name: JNPA Main Harbour Navigation Channel (Tidal Permissible Draft)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Maximum permissible vessel sailing draft in Main Channel is 15.00m CD. Requires tidal height >= 2.20m and minimum static UKC of 1.50m (JNPA Circular No. MD/PH/2023/04).
restrictions.source_publication_reference: JNPA Marine Department Guidelines Circular No. MD/PH/2023/04, Section 1 ("Main Navigational Channel Draft & UKC Requirements")

restrictions.scope_name: BMCT Berths 1 & 2 (High Tide Sailing Draft Extension)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Permissible draft alongside is 15.00m CD baseline; conditional extension up to 15.50m CD permitted with high tide height >= 3.00m.
restrictions.source_publication_reference: JNPA Marine Department Guidelines Circular No. MD/PH/2023/04, Section 3 ("Terminal Berthing Criteria"), Table 2

restrictions.scope_name: Paradip Berth 03 (NCIB High Tide Sailing Draft Extension)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Permissible draft alongside is 16.00m CD baseline; high tide sailing extension up to 16.50m CD permitted for Berth 03 (NCIB) during spring tides.
restrictions.source_publication_reference: PPA Marine Department Circular No. MD/SC/22/2023, Section 2 ("Berth-wise Admissible Parameters"), Table 1, Note 2

restrictions.scope_name: Paradip Berths 05 & 06 (Mechanized Coal High Tide Sailing Draft Extension)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Permissible draft alongside is 14.50m CD baseline; high-tide sailing extension up to 16.00m CD permitted during high water window (tide height >= 1.50m).
restrictions.source_publication_reference: PPA Marine Department Circular No. MD/SC/22/2023, Section 2 ("Berth-wise Admissible Parameters"), Table 1, Note 3

restrictions.scope_name: JNPA Main Harbour Navigation Channel (Statutory Static UKC Requirement)
restrictions.operating_conditions: Minimum required static Under-Keel Clearance for deep draft commercial vessels transiting JNPA Main Harbour Channel (JNPA Circular No. MD/PH/2023/04).
restrictions.source_publication_reference: JNPA Marine Department Guidelines Circular No. MD/PH/2023/04, Section 1
